popup.pageTranslateUnavailable: Page translation is not available on this page. Open a normal web page and try again.
popup.noProvider: No active provider configured. Open Settings to add one.
popup.sidePanelNotAvailable: Side panel is not available in this browser.
popup.cannotDetectWindow: Could not detect the browser window.

options.baseUrlPolicy: HTTPS is required except for localhost and 127.0.0.1. Use the final URL without redirects, query parameters, or fragments.
options.firefoxHostPermissionScope: Firefox host permission covers every port on this hostname. Fetch still uses only the saved Base URL, including its port.
options.localKeyStorageUnavailable: This browser cannot restrict content-script access to local storage, so protected local key storage is unavailable. Session storage remains the default.
options.persistentKeyStorageHelp: Firefox persistent keys are stored in IndexedDB on this extension's moz-extension origin and are read only by the background script. This is not a system password manager. It does not resist malware on this computer, a copied Firefox profile, or a compromised extension. Temporary add-ons are removed when Firefox quits; that deletes the store and is not a credential-store failure.
options.persistentKeyStorageUnavailable: Extension-isolated persistent storage is unavailable. The key was not written to unprotected storage.local.
options.probeTabRequired: Select the open fixture tab. The current options tab is not used.
options.unsupportedProbeTab: That tab is not an ordinary http(s) page, so a content-script probe cannot run there.
options.contentScriptMissing: This http(s) page has no content script. Reload the page after loading or updating the extension, then probe again.
options.probeContentIsolationHelp: Keep the fixture tab open, refresh the list, and select that tab explicitly. This does not use the active tab, which is this settings page. Do not repeat the page-origin probe.
options.probeTabListEmpty: No ordinary http(s) tabs are visible. Open /fixture, keep Save and authorize host for 127.0.0.1, then refresh the list.
options.keyConfigured: A key is configured. Enter a new key only to replace it.
options.fastModeWarning: May cost more. Requires relay and model support; speed and pricing are determined by the relay. Connection tests also request Priority. Unsupported requests are not automatically resent in standard mode.
options.fastModeRejected: The relay rejected the Priority service tier. Check relay/model support or turn Fast mode off, save, and retry manually. No standard-mode request was automatically sent.
options.priorityNotConfirmed: The server did not report priority for this request. Fast mode is not confirmed; check the relay usage log. The request will not be resent automatically.
options.redirectNotAllowed: The relay redirected the request or returned an unconfirmable redirect. Enter the final Base URL that does not redirect, then save and test again.
options.saveBeforeDiagnostics: Save and authorize changes before running diagnostics.
options.batchDiagnosticsHelp: Records batch timings only. No source text, translations, or keys. Header time is not model first-token time. At most 40 in-memory rows; nothing is written to storage. Re-enable after the background worker restarts.
options.batchDiagnosticsEmpty: No batch timings yet. Enable, translate a page, then refresh.
options.batchItemsHelp: 0 means no item cap; the character limit still applies. Batches are not split by translation length. Already dispatched timed-out batches are not automatically split and resent.
options.concurrencyHelp: Default is 2. All tabs share one limit. 5–10 is an advanced range; do not start at the maximum.
options.streamTranslationsHelp: Complete items appear before the batch finishes. A failed stream is not automatically resent as a non-streaming request.
options.taskTiming: Task: first write acknowledgement {{write}} ms, task end {{end}} ms, fetches {{fetch}}. The acknowledgement is not the page textContent clock. A retry row starts at that attempt's dispatch.
options.gatewayRetryWarning: Keep this off unless the relay guarantees the request was not executed or implements idempotency using X-Translation-Request-Id.
options.selectionPageDesc: Default languages for text selection and full-page translation. Popup and side panel use separate language preferences.
options.fallbackDesc: When the default provider fails, LinguaLens tries these providers in order. Leave empty to disable fallback.
options.noProviders: No providers configured. Add one above.
options.disableThinkingDesc: Skip model reasoning for faster translation
options.ollamaCorsWarning: Ollama requires CORS configuration for browser extensions. Start Ollama with:
options.promptTemplateDesc: Customize the system prompt for LLM-based providers. Available variables:
options.strategyQualityDesc: Translate larger blocks for better context and quality
options.strategySpeedDesc: Translate smaller chunks for faster progressive results
options.selectionTriggerModeDesc: How text selection triggers translation on web pages.
options.triggerModeIconDesc: Show a floating icon near the selection — click to translate
options.triggerModeInstantDesc: Translate immediately when text is selected
options.triggerModeModifierDesc: Press a key after selecting text to translate
options.triggerModeOffDesc: No reaction on text selection (use Alt+T or context menu)
options.selectionModifierKeyDesc: Press this key alone after selecting text to translate.
options.keyboardShortcutsDesc: Default shortcuts (if assigned by the browser): <kbd>Alt+T</kbd> translate selection, <kbd>Alt+Shift+T</kbd> translate page, <kbd>Alt+M</kbd> cycle selection trigger mode (icon → instant → modifier → off). Selecting text with the mouse shows the floating trigger in icon mode — the shortcut is mainly for keyboard-first use. If a shortcut does nothing, open shortcut settings and bind LinguaLens to a free combination. Content scripts do not run on restricted pages (browser internal URLs or extension store pages).
options.welcomeDesc: Before translating, set up at least one provider below. Ollama and LM Studio work locally; cloud APIs need a base URL, model, and API key where required.
options.welcomeStep1: Enable a provider and check its URL and model

statusBar.progressHint: These numbers are scheduled network text chunks, not API request counts. One request can include multiple chunks.
statusBar.batchAnomaly: All translations arrived, but {{count}} request(s) ended abnormally
statusBar.retryUnknownWarning: The relay may already have processed these requests. Retrying can cause duplicate calls. Continue?
